result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and `mvn -q -o test` passes. I didn't add a test for the new field, so nothing checks that a description actually comes back in the lists.

- **`schema.sql`**: the `promotion` table has a new nullable `description VARCHAR(500)` column. The schema is only created from scratch, so a database that already exists won't pick up the column.
- **`Promotion.java`**: the record has a new last component, `description`. I kept a 6-argument constructor that sets it to null, so `PromotionService` and the existing tests compile unchanged. That means `PromotionService` can't set a description yet, only `DataStore.createPromotion` can.
- **`DataStore.java`**: `createPromotion` inserts the description and returns it. `findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion` and `listUnusedPromotions` all select and map it. Promotions without one come back with null.

I didn't commit.
